name: multi_omics_mofa_chain
display_name: Multi-Omics Integration — MOFA+ Factor Analysis & Biomarker Discovery
description: Integrates multiple omics layers — RNA-seq, proteomics, and metabolomics — into a unified latent factor model using MOFA+ (Multi-Omics Factor Analysis v2). Step 1: per-modality preprocessing and normalisation (DESeq2 VST for RNA, MaxQuant LFQ for proteomics, XCMS for metabolomics). Step 2: MOFA+ joint factor decomposition to identify axes of variation shared across modalities. Step 3: downstream analysis — factor-to-phenotype association, cross-layer biomarker identification, and pathway enrichment per factor. Use for: multi-omics biomarker discovery, integrative cancer biology, systems biology phenotyping, and cross-modality mechanistic hypothesis generation.
